rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion narrow, grounding reversal in Whitman’s intelligible-principle framework and Sunshine Anthracite’s governmental-control model while rejecting a special nondelegation rule for revenue-raising mechanisms (Skinner). Thomas and Gorsuch are likely to write separately (possibly separately from each other) to press originalist objections about uncapped compulsory exactions and the practical private-delegation features of USAC’s role.
